Maria G.: Quick heads-up — onboarding run for Lucent-small-300 (embedding model) with int6 quant + batched encoder finished in staging. Seeing a consistent recall@5 drop for short queries (~<8 tokens). Anyone else?
Rahul: Noted. Numbers?
Maria G.: Baseline (Lucent fp16): short queries recall@5 = 0.78, long queries recall@5 = 0.85
Maria G.: Lucent int6 (batch-size 64): short queries recall@5 = 0.62, long queries recall@5 = 0.84
Kevin L.: Oof. Long queries look fine, so KV/cache and sequence handling probably fine. Short queries sensitivity => quantization noise near origin?
Sophie P.: Did you run whiten/normalization parity tests? Sometimes tiny norms explode relative distances after quantization.
Maria G.: Ran postproc parity: L2 norm mean differs: fp16=1.02, int6=0.98 on holdout. But cosine shift distribution shows a small left shift.
Rahul: Can you paste the eval command?
Maria G.: Sure:
```
python run_eval.py --model lucent-small-300 --quant int6 --batch-size 64 --queries holdout_short.txt --metrics recall@1,5,10 --seed 42
```
Kevin L.: Try lowering batch-size to 8 or disable microbatching. Batching changes internal activation scaling sometimes with our fused kernels. Also try per-channel asymmetric quant instead of symmetric if available.
Sophie P.: I pushed a quick UMAP snapshot to the internal plots: https://redwood-internal/plots/lucent_int6_umap_short.png — clusters look slightly more smeared near centroid for several classes. :eyes:
Maria G.: Yup saw that. KMeans purity down ~0.04 for short-query clusters.
Rahul: embed-ci reports the nightly regression too?
embed-ci: nightly-eval: lucent-small-300:int6 — recall@5_short delta = -0.16 vs baseline at 2026-03-20T03:12Z. Full logs: https://ci.internal/builds/4421/logs
Kevin L.: Two quick experiments: (1) run int6 with per-channel scaling (--quant-mode per-channel) (2) run int6 + bias-correction post-quant. Also compare float32-run outputs for tiny queries to ensure no data/seed drift.
Maria G.: On it. Spawning jobs now: job ids 8842 (per-channel), 8843 (bias-corr), 8844 (batch-size=8).
Sophie P.: Also try skyline normalization before indexing: normalize embeddings to unit length after quant-dequant. Sometimes that stabilizes cosine recall.
Maria G.: Added normalization to job 8843 as a variant.
Rahul: If per-channel + norm gets us within 0.02 of baseline, we can consider int6 for cost wins but gate on short-query eval flag.
Kevin L.: Also double-check tokenizer: short queries are often 1-3 tokens and we saw different tokenization on staging vs eval harness before. Small mismatch can amplify.
Maria G.: Confirmed tokenizer version matches.
Maria G.: Quick interim results job 8842 (per-channel): recall@5_short = 0.70 — improvement but still -0.08 delta.
Maria G.: job 8843 (bias-corr + norm): recall@5_short = 0.76 — only -0.02 delta.
Sophie P.: Nice. What's the latency/cost delta for int6 at that config?
Maria G.: int6 per-token GFLOP ~0.48x, observed 1.9x throughput vs fp16 on our staging box (good). Latency p50 up ~5ms due to extra dequant step.
Rahul: Sounds acceptable if quality delta is small. We should add a canary: route 5% of short-query traffic to lucent-int6 with bias-corr + norm and measure production recall metrics + user-impact signals.
Kevin L.: Agree. Also add a fallback policy: if recall@5_short drops >0.05 on canary, auto-fallback to fp16.
Maria G.: Will create canary config and rollout plan. Drafted PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rollouts/pull/129 — includes fallback and metric thresholds.
Sophie P.: Add eval hooks to Console to show short-query cohort specifically. We need per-route token histograms + recall by query length.
Rahul: I'll add the console widget.
embed-ci: canary-run queued: job 8890. Will post results at ~+2h.
Maria G.: Thanks all. Action items: 1) run canary (Rahul) 2) rollouts PR review (Kevin) 3) monitor UMAP cluster drift for first 24h (Sophie) 4) ship doc on int6 caveats for short queries (Maria).
Kevin L.: I'll review the PR in ~30m.
Sophie P.: I'll set up an alert if cluster purity drops >0.03.
Maria G.: Closing notes: good tradeoff if bias-correct + norm in pipeline. Will update thread after canary. :thumbsup:
